caveats: Experimental: Paseo >=0.11.0 (SDK-tested with 0.11.4 and 0.15.4), daemon Node >=22.19, and a separately installed official DSH with credentials.

Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 or newer (no-inference provider checks through 0.2.2-rc.2). DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 requires Node >=24.9; configured-session history recovery requires beta.19; beta.21 also handles all 63 published v4 event types, including Team-mode metadata, and explicitly ignorable informational events. Correlated compaction/pruning preserves original messages and full tool output; attachments and unknown replacements remain unsupported. Plugins and DSH tools are trusted, unsandboxed code.

Restores native DSH context and, on Paseo 0.13+, replays recognised v4 text logs from the session DSH_HOME. Missing, corrupt, unsupported or over-limit logs leave an empty timeline without blocking resume.
The Usage panel reads the DeepSeek API key the way DSH does and sends it only to DeepSeek's balance endpoint.
No raw token deltas, slash commands, steering, plans or terminal UI; image history is not replayed and real MCP services are untested.
Discovery can leave empty DSH sessions; DSH profiles are authoritative and Paseo's extra system prompt is not injected.

Real macOS daemon turns passed on Paseo 0.11.4, 0.12.0-beta.2, 0.13.0, 0.13.2 and 0.14.0. Text/tool history recovery was checked on the macOS 0.15.3 desktop without a new model prompt. Windows automated tests and isolated daemon smoke pass in CI; other desktop and native mobile UI remain unverified.
